summary: Only ansible-core is needed to test modules; modules can be in any language, but those included in Ansible must be Python or PowerShell, which also get module_utils help with arguments, logging and responses.
questions: What do I need installed to start developing modules?
What languages are allowed for modules included in Ansible?

answer_card.title: Module development environment
answer_card.answer_md: You only need `ansible-core`. Modules can be in any language, but those included in Ansible must be **Python or PowerShell**, which also let you use `module_utils` for argument handling, logging and responses.
